Delta_Trigram.source: research features.csv (92,299 HDTB pairs), rescored with the Katz-backoff trigram

meta.method: abs(standardized univariate logistic coefficient), Joachims pairwise transform, C=1e6

provenance.others: Ranjan & van Schijndel research features.csv (hi_hdtb-ud-train.conllu, SOV+DOSV+IOSV, 92,299 pairs; same models as our scorers)
provenance.Delta_Surprisal: computed on those pairs' surfaces via Taru synproc (batch_surprisal.py, Docker)
provenance.Delta_Trigram: refit 2026-08-29 when the trigram scorer was replaced by the Katz-backoff model. Same 92,299 pairs and same univariate fit that produced the old 1.8816 / 77.09%, so this is a like-for-like upgrade on identical rows: 77.09% -> 89.52%. Almost all of the gain is the scoring function (<s> <s> padding and training-time normalization), not the model — the old pickle scored the new way reaches 82.14% against the new model's 82.16% on the app's 48,864 Paninian pairs. See trigram_compare/REPORT.md.
